subject: Request for quotation from Weidner Spielwaren GmbH
body:
Hello,

please find our request for an air freight quotation attached, as a PDF file (quotation-request.pdf). It has all details of the shipment.

Please reply by mail with your all-in price in EUR.

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
